verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's own `post-video` CLI accepts `--at <datetime> --tz <zone>`, so a finished video can be scheduled to publish to TikTok, Instagram or YouTube at a set time (gh-9, gh-14). That is one-off timed posting, not recurring jobs. Nothing shows cron-like recurrence or scheduled video-generation workflows. Pause/resume on limits (docs-10) is not scheduling, so it gets no credit. missing for 10: recurring schedules (cron/interval), scheduling of generation jobs or workflows rather than single posts, schedule management (list/edit/cancel), first-party docs and independent corroboration of the scheduling feature.
